tracercoin-0.21.5.5-win64-setup-BRANDTEST.exe
================================================

WHAT THIS IS
  A real, working Windows installer (NSIS) built from tracercoin-setup.nsi.
  Use it to test the INSTALLER experience on another device:
    - Tracercoin (TFX) branding: window icon, wizard side-banner, header logo
    - Wizard flow: Welcome -> Directory -> Start-Menu -> Install -> Finish
    - Installs to C:\Program Files\Tracercoin
    - Start-menu shortcuts (main + testnet + uninstall)
    - "tracercoin:" URI protocol handler registered
    - Clean uninstall

IMPORTANT CAVEAT (read before judging the wallet)
  The five wallet executables inside are PLACEHOLDERS -- they are the stock
  Litecoin 0.21.5.5 binaries renamed to tracercoin-qt.exe / tracercoind.exe /
  etc. They exist ONLY so the installer had something to package for this build.
  If you launch the installed wallet it will behave like Litecoin (wrong network),
  NOT the Tracercoin chain.

  This is because the real Win64 Tracercoin binaries have not been cross-compiled
  yet (they build on the Linux droplet). Once those exist, the SAME installer
  script produces the real product -- just point makensis at the real release
  folder:
      makensis /DRELEASE=<folder with real tracercoin-*.exe> tracercoin-setup.nsi

SO: test the setup/branding/flow freely. Do not use the installed wallet for
real TFX yet.

Built 2026-07-26. Branding art: brand\ (from make-brand-art.py). Script: ../tracercoin-setup.nsi
